MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.

2. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

3. When practising Oral Expressions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expressions.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expressions.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expressions.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expressions.

4. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.

5. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.

6. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
